name: B10-0579/2025 (ECR) – Grave political situation in Guinea-Bissau after the coup of 26 November
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the grave political situation in Guinea-Bissau after the coup of 26 November
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns the military coup in Guinea-Bissau on 26 November 2025, which took place just before election results were announced. It calls for the release of everyone held without legal process and for the country's constitutional order to be restored. It urges all sides to avoid violence and respect basic rights and freedoms. It also asks West African and African Union bodies to help Guinea-Bissau return to democratic rule, and asks the European Union's office there to keep watching the situation closely.

- The Parliament condemns the coup and demands the release of all arbitrarily detained people.
- It calls on all sides to avoid violence and respect rights and freedoms.
- It asks regional bodies to help restore democratic order and the EU office to monitor events.
